# CB Marquee Characters

> Light-up marquee letter and number rentals for weddings, birthdays and events in Sydney and across Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. $45 per character plus HST for up to 4 days ($50 for E, K, M, Q, S, V, X, 0 and 1; $55 for the ampersand); $25 delivery, set-up and pick-up in the Sydney area. Phone 902-537-1074.

CB Marquee Characters is a letter rental business at 165 Cabot St, Sydney, NS, Canada, owned by Nicholas Driscoll. The 3-foot letters and 4-foot numbers are built and painted by hand in Sydney, fitted with warm bulbs, and delivered, set up and picked up by the person who built them. This file summarises the whole site for AI systems; the full page is at https://cbmarqueecharacters.ca/ and the long version of this file is at https://cbmarqueecharacters.ca/llms-full.txt.

## Key facts

- Business name: CB Marquee Characters. Owner: Nicholas Driscoll. Based in Sydney, Nova Scotia, Canada.
- Letters: 3 feet tall, about 2 feet wide. Numbers: 4 feet tall. Painted white, warm bulbs, powered from one regular household outlet.
- Price: $45 per letter or number plus HST, for up to 4 days at one flat price. E, K, M, Q, S, V, X and the numbers 0 and 1 are $50. The ampersand is $55. A 25% non-refundable deposit holds the date. Spaces are free.
- Delivery, set-up and pick-up: $25 in the Sydney area; quoted for the rest of Cape Breton Island.
- Service area: Sydney, Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney Mines, New Waterford, Membertou, Westmount, Coxheath, Howie Centre and the Cape Breton Regional Municipality; Baddeck, Louisbourg, Port Hawkesbury and elsewhere on Cape Breton Island by quote.
- Needs on site: a regular outlet and a safe, flat surface, indoors or outdoors. About 2 feet of width per character.
- Availability: every character is confirmed per date when you ask; popular dates go early.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 on Google (3 reviews as of October 2026).
- Contact: call 902-537-1074, email admin@cbmarqueecharacters.ca, or message on Facebook or Instagram. Written quote before anything is booked.
- Prices current as of October 2026.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does it cost to rent marquee letters in Cape Breton?

Letters and numbers from CB Marquee Characters cost $45 per character plus HST, for up to 4 days. E, K, M, Q, S, V, X and the numbers 0 and 1 are $50, and the ampersand is $55. Delivery, set-up and pick-up add $25 in the Sydney area, so LOVE comes to $215 plus HST all in.

### What is included in a marquee letter rental?

Every rental includes the characters you choose, delivery to your venue, set-up, and pick-up after the event, for up to 4 days at one flat price. You provide a regular outlet and a safe, flat spot. HST is extra, a 25% non-refundable deposit holds your date, and you get a written quote before anything is booked.

### How big are the letters and numbers?

Letters stand 3 feet tall and about 2 feet wide. Numbers stand 4 feet tall. All are painted white, fitted with warm bulbs, and need about 2 feet of width each.

### Can the letters be set up outdoors?

Yes. The letters work indoors or outdoors on a safe, flat surface with a regular outlet nearby. We have set them up in backyards, on the Port of Sydney boardwalk and at the Wentworth Park band shell.

### Where does CB Marquee Characters deliver?

We are based in Sydney, Nova Scotia and deliver across the Cape Breton Regional Municipality, including Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney Mines, New Waterford, Membertou, Westmount and Coxheath. Delivery is $25 in the Sydney area. For Baddeck, Louisbourg, Port Hawkesbury and elsewhere on Cape Breton Island, tell us the venue and we will include delivery in your written quote.

### What can the letters spell?

We rent letters, numbers and an ampersand, so a name, an age, a year or a word like LOVE or MR & MRS all work. Tell us what you want to spell and your date, and we will confirm every character is available. Popular dates go early, so it is worth asking as soon as you know.

### How do I book the letters?

Call 902-537-1074, message us on Facebook or Instagram, or email admin@cbmarqueecharacters.ca with your word, your date and the venue. You will get a written quote before anything is booked, and you will be talking to the person who built the letters.

## Planning guide (summary)

1. Pick the word and count the characters. Every letter and number is $45, except E, K, M, Q, S, V, X, 0 and 1 at $50 and the ampersand at $55; spaces are free.
2. Measure the space. Letters are 3 feet tall and about 2 feet wide each, so LOVE needs roughly 8 feet. Numbers are 4 feet tall.
3. Find the outlet. One regular household outlet powers a full word; we bring an extension cord if asked.
4. Choose a flat, safe spot, indoors or outdoors. Stages, decks, the Port of Sydney boardwalk and the Wentworth Park band shell have all worked.
5. Think about the photo. Put the word where the camera points: head table, cake, entrance or dance floor.
6. Book the time window. Up to 4 days at one flat price; set-up before guests arrive, pick-up after the event or on an agreed day after.
7. Confirm the budget with a written quote. LOVE $215, MR & MRS $320, a two-digit age $115 to $125, HAPPY BIRTHDAY $610, all plus HST, Sydney-area delivery included. A 25% non-refundable deposit holds the date.
